incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for customer 'Pegasus Finance' (VPC, dedicated pool: pegasus-prod-eu1-pool) in eu-west-1. p95=420ms -> 1200ms, p99=1.2s -> 5.8s, error rate +1.4%. Auto-escalation to #incidents triggered.

maya (oncall): acked. paging @samir and @ryan. I'll start triage.

samir: on it. pulling per-tenant qps and tail latencies. suspect heavy KV-cache misses + one noisy tenant. running queries now.

ops-bot: Metric snapshot attached: pool_consumption=94%, avg_seq_len=720, kv_cache_hit=62%. Recent rollout: model v3.1.4-quant applied 12m ago to pegasus-prod-eu1-pool.

ella (cs): Pegasus CS here — customers reporting timeouts in production via our support queue. They see degraded UX on billing flows. they asked if we have a mitigation ETA.

maya (oncall): thanks @ella. Samir, if it's a noisy tenant we can isolate traffic or apply token-based rate-limits for Pegasus internal jobs. What's the qps breakdown?

samir: top tenants: pegasus-web=46%, pegasus-batch=38%, pegasus-internal-worker=12%, others=4%. The internal worker has long sequences (~2000 tokens) causing big KV cache thrash.

ryan (infra): I can spin up extra replicas for the pool and push a quick routing change to fallback model (v3.1.3-fp16) which is slightly cheaper/lower-latency. Want me to run scale and route now?

maya (oncall): yes. do both in parallel. Add replicas + route a small % (20%) first. use canary then widen. log commands here.

ryan (infra): executing now:
```
redwoodctl pool scale --pool pegasus-prod-eu1-pool --replicas +2
redwoodctl route set --pool pegasus-prod-eu1-pool --model v3.1.3-fp16 --weight 20% --canary
```

ops-bot: Pool scale started. new replica tasks provisioning on g4dn-equivalent nodes. Estimated warmup 90s.

samir: while that ramps, I'll configure a temporary per-tenant concurrency cap on pegasus-internal-worker: 2 concurrent requests and a soft rate-limit of 10rps. Applying now.

samir: command:
```
redwoodctl tenant throttle --tenant pegasus-internal-worker --pool pegasus-prod-eu1-pool --concurrency 2 --rps 10 --duration 15m --reason "temp isolate noisy tenant"
```

ops-bot: Tenant throttle applied (id: thr-9876).

maya (oncall): seeing p99 drop to ~2.1s and p95 to ~650ms after throttle and canary routing. still above SLO but trending down. share to customer? @ella, can you notify Pegasus that we've enacted isolation and are scaling?

ella (cs): will message ops channel + create support update. telling them: temporary throttling for internal jobs + routing to fallback model during investigation. ask if they'd like us to pause internal jobs — they replied: "please pause if it helps, we'll coordinate."

samir: one more tweak — disable recent quantized kernel for model v3.1.4 on pool to see effect. flip flag and monitor.

ryan (infra): disabled quant kernel on pegasus-prod-eu1-pool: `--kernel-quant=false`. rolling restart on 2 nodes applied.

ops-bot: After mitigations: p95=340ms, p99=880ms, pool_consumption=72%, kv_cache_hit=78%, error rate back to baseline.

maya (oncall): great. will keep this thread open for handoff. @kevin (oncall-next) you'll take the 2hr follow-up: monitor for recurrence, coordinate with Pegasus to resume internal jobs, and prepare post-incident notes.

kevin (oncall-next): taking handoff. summary for handoff channel:
- customer: Pegasus Finance (VPC, dedicated pool pegasus-prod-eu1-pool)
- root cause (candidate): noisy long-sequence tenant causing KV-cache thrash + recent quant kernel interaction
- mitigations applied: tenant throttle (thr-9876), pool scale + 20% canary routing to v3.1.3-fp16, disabled quant kernel on v3.1.4, rolling restart on 2 nodes
- status: p99 under SLO at 880ms, continuing monitoring, support update sent
- follow-ups: remove throttle once Pegasus pauses internal jobs, run eval comparing v3.1.3 vs v3.1.4 quant kernels on representative prompt set, and consider autoscaling tweak for long-seq tails

kevin (oncall-next): I'll update incident ticket and start a short RCA doc draft. tagging @samir and @ryan for action items.

maya (oncall): thanks team. closing the active paging. :white_check_mark: keep this thread for the handoff notes and RCA link.

ella (cs): Pegasus confirmed they'll pause internal worker for 30m; will post when resumed.

samir: logging this as postmortem item: kernel-quant interaction with long sequences. saving logs: `/var/logs/pegasus/2026-03-15-pool-metrics.log` and creating eval run ticket CLI: `evals create --name pegasus-quant-regression --prompts /ops/pegasus/long-seq-prompts.json`.
